invariants.name: balance_conservation
invariants.english: Money at the start equals money left plus the money successful withdrawals took.
invariants.sql: SELECT 1 FROM initial_state i, wallet w WHERE i.balance <> w.balance + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ops_log WHERE endpoint = '/withdraw' AND status = 200), 0)
invariants.note: passes the filter; needs human approval

invariants.name: total_withdrawn_within_initial
invariants.english: Successful withdrawals never add up to more than the starting balance.
invariants.sql: SELECT 1 FROM initial_state i WHERE i.balance < COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ops_log WHERE endpoint = '/withdraw' AND status = 200), 0)
invariants.note: passes the filter; needs human approval

invariants.name: no_negative_balance
invariants.english: The balance is never below zero.
invariants.note: never fires under concurrency, cannot detect this bug

invariants.name: no_rejected_requests
invariants.english: DECOY: no request is ever rejected (too strict).
invariants.sql: select op_id from ops_log where status <> 200
invariants.note: fires on one-at-a-time runs, so the rule itself is wrong
